\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 250-253 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:ML-R258-first-pass-words-from-chapters-250-253}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a square and a triangle.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a number, an app, news, a newspaper, a stamp
  \item a computer, a file, a notebook, an eraser, information
  \item a joke, a snake-boat race, the Vishu kani, a Vishu gift of money, a firecracker
  \item a banyan tree, a jackfruit tree, a rose, a hibiscus, holy basil
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A number? (\textbf{\ml{നമ്പർ}}, \emph{nampar}.) An app? (\textbf{\ml{ആപ്പ്}}, \emph{āppŭ}.) News? (\textbf{\ml{വാർത്ത}}, \emph{vārtta}.) A newspaper? (\textbf{\ml{പത്രം}}, \emph{patraṁ}.) A stamp? (\textbf{\ml{സ്റ്റാമ്പ്}}, \emph{sṟṟāmpŭ}.) A computer? (\textbf{\ml{കമ്പ്യൂട്ടർ}}, \emph{kampyūṭṭar}.) A file? (\textbf{\ml{ഫയൽ}}, \emph{phayal}.) A notebook? (\textbf{\ml{നോട്ടുബുക്ക്}}, \emph{nōṭṭubukkŭ}.) An eraser? (\textbf{\ml{റബ്ബർ}}, \emph{ṟabbar}.) Information? (\textbf{\ml{വിവരം}}, \emph{vivaraṁ}.) A joke? (\textbf{\ml{തമാശ}}, \emph{tamāśa}.) A snake-boat race? (\textbf{\ml{വള്ളംകളി}}, \emph{vaḷḷaṁkaḷi}.) The Vishu kani? (\textbf{\ml{കണി}}, \emph{kaṇi}.) A Vishu gift of money? (\textbf{\ml{കൈനീട്ടം}}, \emph{kainīṭṭaṁ}.) A firecracker? (\textbf{\ml{പടക്കം}}, \emph{paṭakkaṁ}.) A banyan tree? (\textbf{\ml{ആൽമരം}}, \emph{ālmaraṁ}.) A jackfruit tree? (\textbf{\ml{പ്ലാവ്}}, \emph{plāvŭ}.) A rose? (\textbf{\ml{റോസാപ്പൂ}}, \emph{ṟōsāppū}.) A hibiscus? (\textbf{\ml{ചെമ്പരത്തി}}, \emph{cemparatti}.) Holy basil? (\textbf{\ml{തുളസി}}, \emph{tuḷasi}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 254-258 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:ML-R258-second-pass-words-from-chapters-254-258}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a sparrow and a squirrel.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a sparrow, a squirrel, a crab, a tail, a wing
  \item a laptop, a screen, a website, a camera, a printer
  \item entertainment, a toy, an opinion, an idea, advice
  \item a roof tile, a pillar, a corridor, a bedroom, a wide bronze cooking vessel
  \item paint, a shape, a circle, a square, a triangle
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A sparrow? (\textbf{\ml{കുരുവി}}, \emph{kuruvi}.) A squirrel? (\textbf{\ml{അണ്ണാൻ}}, \emph{aṇṇān}.) A crab? (\textbf{\ml{ഞണ്ട്}}, \emph{ñaṇṭŭ}.) A tail? (\textbf{\ml{വാൽ}}, \emph{vāl}.) A wing? (\textbf{\ml{ചിറക്}}, \emph{ciṟakŭ}.) A laptop? (\textbf{\ml{ലാപ്ടോപ്പ്}}, \emph{lāpṭōppŭ}.) A screen? (\textbf{\ml{സ്ക്രീൻ}}, \emph{skrīn}.) A website? (\textbf{\ml{വെബ്സൈറ്റ്}}, \emph{vebsaiṟṟŭ}.) A camera? (\textbf{\ml{ക്യാമറ}}, \emph{kyāmaṟa}.) A printer? (\textbf{\ml{പ്രിന്റർ}}, \emph{prinṟar}.) Entertainment? (\textbf{\ml{വിനോദം}}, \emph{vinōdaṁ}.) A toy? (\textbf{\ml{കളിപ്പാട്ടം}}, \emph{kaḷippāṭṭaṁ}.) An opinion? (\textbf{\ml{അഭിപ്രായം}}, \emph{abhiprāyaṁ}.) An idea? (\textbf{\ml{ആശയം}}, \emph{āśayaṁ}.) Advice? (\textbf{\ml{ഉപദേശം}}, \emph{upadēśaṁ}.) A roof tile? (\textbf{\ml{ഓട്}}, \emph{ōṭŭ}.) A pillar? (\textbf{\ml{തൂണ്}}, \emph{tūṇŭ}.) A corridor? (\textbf{\ml{ഇടനാഴി}}, \emph{iṭanāḻi}.) A bedroom? (\textbf{\ml{കിടപ്പുമുറി}}, \emph{kiṭappumuṟi}.) A wide bronze cooking vessel? (\textbf{\ml{ഉരുളി}}, \emph{uruḷi}.) Paint? (\textbf{\ml{ചായം}}, \emph{cāyaṁ}.) A shape? (\textbf{\ml{ആകൃതി}}, \emph{ākṛti}.) A circle? (\textbf{\ml{വൃത്തം}}, \emph{vṛttaṁ}.) A square? (\textbf{\ml{ചതുരം}}, \emph{caturaṁ}.) A triangle? (\textbf{\ml{ത്രികോണം}}, \emph{trikōṇaṁ}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
